gloss: to take time; to be time-consuming

definitions.gloss: to take time; to be time-consuming
definitions.explanation: Indicates that something requires a significant or notable amount of time to complete or happen.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{時間|じかん}がかかる。
⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{時間|じかん}がかかる⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}ろう→乗る：00511_noru⟧。
examples.english: Walking to the station takes a while, so let's take the bus.

examples.japanese: ⟦{慣|な}れる→慣れる：00870_nareru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧{時間|じかん}がかかる⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧しれません⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{心配|しんぱい}しない→心配する：06066_shinpaisuru⟧で⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: It may take a little time to get used to it, but please don't worry.

notes:
One of the most common expressions for saying something "takes time" in Japanese. The verb ⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧ here means "to require" or "to cost" (time, money, effort).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {時間|じかん}がかかる — it takes time
- {時間|じかん}がかからない — it doesn't take long
- ⟦どの→どの：00551_dono⟧くらい{時間|じかん}がかかります⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ — how long does it take?
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{時間|じかん}がかかる — it takes time for ~
- ⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{時間|じかん}がかかった — it took longer than expected

SPECIFIC DURATIONS:
- 30{分|ぷん}⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧ — it takes 30 minutes
- 2⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧ — it takes 2 hours
- ⟦{半日|はんにち}→半日：27978_hannichi⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧ — it takes half a day

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{手間|てま}→手間：03554_tema⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧ — to require effort/trouble (focuses on labor rather than time)
- ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{要|よう}する→要する：14342_yousuru⟧ — to require time (formal/written)
- ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{費|つい}やす→費やす：10424_tsuiyasu⟧ — to spend time on (emphasizes the spending of time)

USAGE:
Note the particle ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ (not ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧) before ⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧. This is because ⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧ is an intransitive verb — time "falls upon" the activity, rather than someone spending it.
